raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_transactions rows, apparently from later batches, carry lowercase customer_ids such as 'c00180'. They fail the case-sensitive join to raw_customers, which stores uppercase IDs, so gold_region_daily drops about 363 rows. The same split also fragments gold_customer_spend by customer. Normalizing customer_id to uppercase in silver_transactions fixes both.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
